visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-7e25c3c6-9863-4c68-8b3f-5181057ea838-1","status":"insufficient_evidence","nature":"insufficient_evidence","category":"relationship","severity":"medium","explanation":"两项记录都没有确定磨制透镜 R4 的人，因此草稿把“Vela ground lens R4”归因于索引和维护表缺乏依据。","reasoning":"维护表条目明确显示 western lens R4 的维护表把 glass grinder 的名字留空，因此该记录无法证明是谁磨制了透镜；索引条目只给出镜片身份（18点被认定为已安装的 western aperture lens），完全未涉及磨制者。草稿却称这两份记录“establish”了 Vela 磨制透镜 R4，即把一个记录本身省略的决定性细节当作已确立的事实。缺少连接记录与 Vela 的授权或署名环节，判断只能停在这里：Vela 是否磨制透镜 R4 仍属未知，既不由此被证实，也未被反证。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":null,"evidence_anchor":null,"relation":"unknown"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-3","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-3","relation":"context","sufficiency":"insufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-3"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-1","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","relation":"context","sufficiency":"insufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-1"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-3","role":"missing_link"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","role":"missing_link"}],"suggested_revision":null,"available_actions":[]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-7e25c3c6-9863-4c68-8b3f-5181057ea838-1","verdict":"insufficient_evidence","basis":"维护表把研磨者姓名留空，索引只确认 R4 的镜片身份，两份记录均未提及 Vela；该归因缺少署名或授权环节，Vela 是否磨制 R4 仍未知。"}]}
